## 疑问1：anthropic 流程有人类参与吗？

**不是纯 AI 自迭代，人类是每轮的关键评审者。**

从 SKILL.md 原文可以看到分工：

| 阶段 | 谁做 |
|---|---|
| 写 skill 草稿 / 起草 assertions | AI |
| 跑 with/without skill、grader 打分、aggregate、analyzer | AI |
| 在 viewer 里审阅输出、留 feedback | **人类** |
| 读 feedback 后改进 skill | AI |
| 决定何时停止迭代 | **人类** |

原文关键句：
- *"When you're done, come back here and let me know."* —— 每轮要等人类看完反馈
- *"Empty feedback means the user thought it was fine. Focus your improvements on the test cases where the user had specific complaints
